messages.text: clamp returns low below the range, high above it, and the value inside it. Implement every branch and cover it. Printing a coverage table from a test is not coverage.

I need to review the existing code and tests to understand the current implementation of the `clamp` function and identify any missing branches. I will first list the contents of the workspace directory to locate the relevant files.
